models.name: Snap-open card packaging machine
models.summary: The KP-4 forms heat-sealed card packs for liquids and pastes. Servo-driven registration aligns the bottom and cover webs in a four-lane sealing layout.
models.application: Single-dose card packs for liquids and pastes, with tooling and opening geometry matched to the product.

models.name: Dual-Web Registered Snap-Open & Sample Sachet Machine
models.summary: Dual-web eye-mark registered packaging machine for V-fold snap-open cards, dual-side printed cosmetic sachets, and single-dose cream/serum packs.
models.application: Designed for cosmetic serums, creams, hair oils, foundation samples, and single-dose gels requiring front-and-back printed artwork alignment and one-hand V-crack dispensing.

models.name: Automatic Flat-Plate Thermoforming & Blister Packaging Machine
models.summary: Flagship 260 mm flat-plate thermoforming, filling, heat-sealing, and die-cutting blister line for cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and daily chemicals.
models.application: Configures for Alu/PVC, Alu/Alu, and PET/Alu blister packs containing capsules, tablets, ampoules, condoms, vape pods, cosmetic masks, or single-dose liquids.

models.name: Mid-Range Flat-Plate Blister & Jelly Cup Packaging Machine
models.summary: Mid-width 155 mm flat-plate thermoforming and blister packaging machine for cosmetic sleeping-mask pods, mouthwash cups, medical syringes, and pharmaceutical blisters.
models.application: Suited for 1-to-4 lane production of dual-color egg masks, 10-15 mL mouthwash cups, dental files, capsules, and medium-batch contract packaging.

models.name: Compact R&D & Small-Batch Blister Packaging Machine
models.summary: Compact 115 mm flat-plate thermoforming and blister packaging machine for pilot laboratories, hospital pharmacies, cosmetic trial batches, and vape/syringe packs.
models.application: Ideal for R&D formulation trials, clinical batches, pre-filled aesthetic syringes, hotel mini perfume pods, vape cartridges, and small-batch tablet/capsule blisters.

models.name: Automatic Double-Aluminum Strip Packaging Machine
models.summary: Rotary heat-sealing soft double-aluminum (Alu/Alu strip) packaging machine for light- and moisture-sensitive tablets, pills, lozenges, and confectionery.
models.application: Seals tablets, coated pills, chewables, and effervescent products between two webs of aluminum-plastic composite foil with automatic vibratory feeding, perforation, and cutting.

models.name: Automatic Paper-Card & Plastic Blister Packaging Machine
models.summary: Automatic rotary/in-line paper-to-plastic blister card sealing machine for cosmetics, lip balms, razors, batteries, hardware, and stationery.
models.application: Seals thermoformed PVC/PET transparent blisters onto heat-seal coated printed paperboard hang-cards for retail pegboard display.

models.name: Alu/PVC and Alu/Alu blister packaging machine
models.summary: The DPK-260H supports aluminium-plastic and aluminium-aluminium blister packaging. Its reference specification separates the cutting cycle and forming depth for the two pack constructions.
models.application: Sealed blister packs for solid items, with the product-feeding arrangement and tooling specified for the intended format.

models.name: Flat-plate blister packaging machine
models.summary: The DPP-250 is a flat-plate blister packaging machine for solid products. The reference configuration uses a 250 mm packaging web, with forming dimensions and utilities listed specifically for the DPP-250.
models.application: Solid-product blister packaging with a product-specific feeder and cavity design.

models.name: Compact blister packaging machine
models.summary: The DPB-80A is a compact blister packaging machine for solid products such as tablets and capsules. Its documented configuration combines programmable control, adjustable operation and forming, sealing and cutting.
models.application: Blister packs for solid products; the feeder and cavity layout must match the actual item.

models.name: Single-Dose Mouthwash Cup Thermoforming Filling & Sealing Line
models.summary: Dedicated 10-20 mL portable mouthwash cup thermoforming, multi-nozzle peristaltic/piston dosing, dual-web eye-mark sealing, and contour die-cutting machine.
models.application: Built for portable 10-15 mL mouthwash cups, jelly cups, liquid laundry pods, and pet antiparasitic drops requiring leak-free peelable sealing.

models.name: Deep-Draw Plug-Assist Hair Mask & Mud Mask Cup Packaging Machine
models.summary: Heavy-duty upper-and-lower plug-assist thermoforming and high-viscosity piston filling machine for 5-30 g hair mask, clay mask, and body scrub cups.
models.application: Engineered for thick cosmetic pastes, hair conditioning capsules, cleansing balms, and mud masks in deep-drawn PP/PET/PVC cups with dual-side registered lidding.

specifications.Hopper options: Single or dual 30 L jacketed agitated hoppers

models.name: 5-head single-dose form-fill-seal machine
models.summary: The GF-120P5 combines plastic forming, liquid filling and pack finishing with 5 filling heads. It is intended for small liquid packs, with the formulation and packaging material specified together.
models.application: Single-dose liquid packs for cosmetic and oral-liquid applications. Suitability depends on the formulation and selected packaging materials.

models.name: 2-head single-dose form-fill-seal machine
models.summary: The GF-120P2 combines plastic forming, liquid filling and pack finishing with 2 filling heads. It is intended for small liquid packs, with the formulation and packaging material specified together.
models.application: Single-dose liquid packs for cosmetic and oral-liquid applications. Suitability depends on the formulation and selected packaging materials.

models.name: Eight-Head Plastic Ampoule Form-Fill-Seal Machine
models.summary: High-capacity 8-nozzle roll-fed plastic ampoule thermoforming, ceramic/peristaltic filling, and twist-off top heat-sealing machine for 1-30 mL single-dose liquids.
models.application: Designed for hyaluronic acid serums, oral nutritional liquids, botanical extracts, eye drops, and veterinary unit doses in standing or flat-tab plastic ampoules.

models.name: Tri-Color Cast Hydrogel Eye & Lip Patch Thermoforming Filling Line
models.summary: Specialized thermal-cast hydrogel eye patch and lip mask thermoforming, multi-hopper heated dosing, extended cooling conveyor, and registered sealing line.
models.application: Built for crystal collagen eye patches, two-tone or three-color swirl hydrogel eye masks, and lip masks cast directly inside thermoformed PVC/PET trays.

specifications.Dosing system: 1, 2, or 3 heated jacketed hoppers with servo piston pumps

models.name: Dual-Registered Two-Color Fish & Egg Mask Blister Packaging Machine
models.summary: Dual-web eye-mark registered thermoforming and dual-nozzle filling line for shaped cosmetic masks (fish-tail, egg-yolk, shell, and capsule sleeping masks).
models.application: Engineered for two-color sleeping masks, collagen jelly pods, and dual-chamber cosmetic blisters where both the formed 3D base and printed lid carry registered graphics.

models.name: Freeze-Dried Mask, Essence Ball & Cold-Form Alu/Alu Blister Machine
models.summary: High-barrier cold-form Alu/Alu and PET/Alu blister packaging line for lyophilized (freeze-dried) cosmetic masks, collagen spheres, and moisture-sensitive actives.
models.application: Seals fragile freeze-dried cosmetic tablets, lyophilized eye patches, and dual-chamber solvent+lyophilized powder blisters under dry, high-barrier conditions.

specifications.Packaging material: Cold-form Alu foil (0.14-0.18 mm) or PET/ALU/PE

models.name: 400 Capsules/Min Automatic Hard Capsule Filling Machine
models.summary: Compact intermittent-motion tamping-pin automatic hard-shell capsule filler for powders, granules, and pellets in #00 to #5 capsules.
models.application: Designed for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and herbal supplement production requiring 24,000 capsules/hour with cGMP enclosed turret indexing.

models.name: 800 Capsules/Min Automatic Hard Capsule Filling Machine
models.summary: Mid-speed 6-bore intermittent tamping-pin automatic capsule filler delivering up to 48,000 capsules/hour for dietary supplements and pharmaceuticals.
models.application: Built for medium-scale contract manufacturers running botanical powders, vitamin blends, and sustained-release pellets in #00-#5 hard capsules.

models.name: 1,200 Capsules/Min High-Speed Automatic Capsule Filling Machine
models.summary: Industrial 9-bore automatic hard capsule filling machine rated up to 72,000 capsules/hour for high-volume pharmaceutical and nutraceutical lines.
models.application: Engineered for continuous three-shift capsule production paired directly with high-speed DPP-260 blister packaging or automatic bottle counting lines.

models.name: 3,500 Capsules/Min Industrial Multi-Bore Capsule Filling Machine
models.summary: Heavy-duty 24-bore industrial hard capsule filling system delivering up to 210,000 capsules/hour for large-scale pharmaceutical plants.
models.application: Built for high-volume solid-dosage plants running large single-SKU capsule batches with automated vacuum powder loading and in-line polishing.

models.name: Pneumatic Semi-Automatic Hard Capsule Filling Machine
models.summary: Stainless-steel 3-motor semi-automatic hard capsule filler combining automatic capsule seeding, horizontal pneumatic locking, and stepless auger powder filling.
models.application: Designed for compounding pharmacies, R&D labs, clinical batches, and small nutraceutical runs of 10,000-25,000 capsules/hour.

models.name: Large-Format Stainless Rotary Bath Bomb, Chlorine & Effervescent Tablet Press
models.summary: Heavy-duty 9-station rotary compression press with 100-150 kN main pressure for large bath salt balls, effervescent tablets, dishwasher blocks, and chlorine pucks.
models.application: Compresses granular powders into large-diameter round, spherical, or custom-shaped blocks up to 30-50 mm diameter and 25 mm thickness.

models.name: 21-Station Automatic Rotary Pharmaceutical & Nutraceutical Tablet Press
models.summary: cGMP 21-station continuous rotary tablet press delivering up to 45,000 tablets/hour for round, oval, caplet, and custom-engraved tablets.
models.application: Designed for pharmaceutical tablets, vitamin chewables, milk tablets, spirulina tablets, and botanical extract tablets up to 16-20 mm diameter.

models.name: Compact 19-Station Benchtop/Floor Rotary Tablet Press
models.summary: Compact small-footprint rotary tablet press (available in 5, 7, 9, and 19 stations) for R&D labs, nutraceutical startups, and small-batch tablet runs.
models.application: Bridges single-punch R&D trials and full industrial rotary production with 9,000-34,000 tablets/hour output in a compact stainless enclosure.

models.name: Flower-Basket Large-Block & Ring Tablet Press Machine
models.summary: Eccentric flower-basket reciprocating press with 70 mm deep fill for large salt blocks, camphor/naphthalene balls, chlorine rings, and ceramic/catalyst preforms.
models.application: Compresses coarse or low-flow chemical, mineral, salt, and veterinary powders into large cylinders, rings, or blocks up to 50 mm diameter and 20-30 mm thickness.

models.name: Single-Punch Desktop & Pilot Tablet Press Machine
models.summary: 60 kN (6-ton) eccentric single-punch tablet press (part of the DYP-1.5T / 5T / 6T series) for R&D formulation screening, university labs, and small candy/herb batches.
models.application: Presses granular powders into round or custom-shaped tablets up to 18-20 mm diameter with adjustable fill depth and tablet thickness.

models.name: Three-Strip Automatic Herbal, Water & Honey Pill Making Machine
models.summary: Automatic vertical three-strip extrusion and synchronous rolling pill maker producing 3-12 mm spherical herbal, water, honey, and nutritional pills.
models.application: Designed for traditional botanical pills, concentrated water pills, honeyed boluses, and functional food spheres at 5-25 kg/hour.

specifications.Pill diameter range: 3-12 mm (one roller size included, others optional)

models.name: Compact Benchtop Water & Honey Pill Making Machine
models.summary: Compact stainless benchtop extruding-and-rolling pill maker with integrated heater for clinics, compounding pharmacies, and pilot botanical labs.
models.application: Produces 1-6 kg/hour of 3-10 mm water pills, water-honey pills, and concentrated herbal pills with easy tabletop disassembly and cleaning.

models.name: 6L / 10L Cryogenic Vibration Cell-Wall-Breaking Superfine Grinder
models.summary: Closed water-cooled/chiller-cooled 3D vibration ball-media superfine mill achieving 200-3,000 mesh (<5-10 um) cell-wall-breaking powder fineness.
models.application: Engineered for high-value Ganoderma (Reishi) spore powder, Dendrobium, Panax notoginseng, pearls, and heat-sensitive cosmetic botanicals.

specifications.Cooling method: Circulating water jacket or industrial chiller (-25 degC)

models.name: 30L / 60L Industrial Cryogenic Vibration Superfine Mill
models.summary: Production-scale 30L-to-100L water/chiller-cooled vibration superfine mill for industrial botanical extracts, mineral pigments, and pharmaceutical powders.
models.application: Scales cell-wall-breaking superfine milling to 5-25 kg per batch for GMP herbal factories, cosmetic powder processors, and specialty chemical plants.

models.name: 370-Type Air-Classified Cyclone & Pulse-Dust Superfine Pulverizer Set
models.summary: Continuous screenless air-classified superfine pulverizer unit with cyclone separator and pulse-jet baghouse collector producing 80-400 mesh powder at 30-200 kg/h.
models.application: Designed for continuous high-output milling of dried roots, grains, spices, talc, cosmetic clays, and pharmaceutical raw materials without screen clogging.

models.name: Water-Cooled Multi-Functional Stainless Toothed-Disc Pulverizer
models.summary: 304 stainless steel water-cooled toothed-disc universal pulverizer (60-180 mesh) for sugar, salt, coffee, grains, spices, and fibrous herbs.
models.application: Delivers 30-150 kg/hour of uniform 60-180 mesh powder with integrated water-cooling jackets around the grinding chamber and spindle bearings.

models.name: Stainless Steel Coarse Crusher & Pre-Breaker Machine
models.summary: Heavy-duty 304 stainless steel claw-and-hammer coarse crusher reducing large roots, barks, shells, minerals, and blocks down to 2-15 mm granules.
models.application: Serves as the essential upstream pre-crusher before fine pulverizers (FS-180-4W, LM-370) or cell-wall-breaking mills (ZD-6L/30L).

models.name: Stainless Steel V-Type Asymmetric Powder & Granule Blender
models.summary: Mirror-polished 304/316L stainless steel asymmetric V-shell tumbler mixer (available from V-50S to V-1000) for high-uniformity dry powder and granule blending.
models.application: Blends pharmaceutical excipients, vitamin premixes, cosmetic talcs, coffee/cocoa powders, and botanical granules prior to capsule filling or tableting.

models.name: 304 Stainless Oscillating Wet & Dry Granulator Machine
models.summary: cGMP 304 stainless steel oscillating rotor granulator (YK-60 / YK-90 / YK-160 series) converting damp powder masses or dry compacts into uniform granules.
models.application: Prepares free-flowing granules for rotary tablet presses (ZP-21, PT-9), hard capsule fillers (NJP-800), and instant beverage sachets (KL-100).

models.name: Rotary & Forced-Air Digital Constant-Temperature Drying Oven
models.summary: Digital PID constant-temperature rotary baking and hot-air circulation drying oven (XH-180S & KX-35AS series) for pills, wet granules, herbs, and grains.
models.application: Uniformly dries wet granules from YK-90, herbal pills from ZW-20S, botanical slices, and food ingredients prior to milling or blister packaging.

models.name: Stainless Steel Water-Chestnut Sugar & Film Coating Machine
models.summary: Inclined 304 stainless steel rotary coating pan (BYC-300 / BYC-400 / BYC-600 / BYC-1000 series) with integrated warm-air blower for tablet, pill, and nut coating.
models.application: Applies sugar coatings, organic/aqueous film coatings, chocolate layers, and carnauba wax polishing to compressed tablets, herbal pills, and confectionery.

models.name: 100-Type Automatic Horizontal Blister & Cosmetic Box Cartoning Machine
models.summary: Continuous/intermittent horizontal automatic cartoner erecting folding cartons, inserting blister cards or cosmetic trays + leaflets, and tuck-closing or hot-melt sealing.
models.application: Connects directly downstream of DPP-260 blister lines, KP-4 card machines, or GF-120P5 ampoule lines to automate retail box packaging at 30-100 cartons/min.

models.name: Automatic 3D Transparent BOPP/PVC Film Box Overwrapping Machine
models.summary: Automatic 3D cellophane/BOPP/PVC film overwrapping and tear-tape applicator (LM-200A & LM-400B series) for cosmetic boxes, perfume cartons, and pharmaceutical packs.
models.application: Wraps single cartons or multi-box bundles in tight, glossy BOPP/PVC film with an easy-open gold/printed tear tape right after cartoning.

specifications.Wrapping material: BOPP / PVC heat-sealable film + tear tape

models.name: Vertical Form-Fill-Seal (VFFS) Powder, Granule & Liquid Sachet Machine
models.summary: Automatic stainless vertical form-fill-seal (KL-100 / DXD-280K series) packaging machine for 3-side seal, 4-side seal, or back-seal pillow sachets.
models.application: Packages herbal granules, protein/collagen powders, coffee, tea bags, tablets, or cosmetic lotions into flexible foil/film sachets at 30-70 bags/min.

specifications.Seal style: 3-side seal, 4-side seal, or back pillow seal

models.name: Stainless Rotary-Disc Tablet, Capsule & Pill Bottle Counting Machine
models.summary: cGMP 304 stainless steel rotary-disc photoelectric/mechanical bottle counting and filling machine for tablets, hard/soft capsules, and herbal pills.
models.application: Counts exact quantities of capsules (from NJP-400C/800), tablets (from ZP-21), or pills (from ZW-20S) into plastic or glass bottles prior to induction sealing and labeling.

models.name: 8-Head Automatic Linear Piston Liquid, Lotion & Paste Bottle Filler
models.summary: Automatic PLC-controlled 8-nozzle (available in 2, 4, 6, 8, 12 heads) linear volumetric piston bottle filling line for cosmetic lotions, shampoos, oils, and sauces.
models.application: Fills glass or plastic bottles (25-1,000 mL) with serums, body washes, creams, essential oils, and liquid detergents on a synchronized stainless conveyor.

models.name: Automatic Self-Adhesive Round/Flat Bottle & Box Labeling Machine
models.summary: Servo-driven pressure-sensitive self-adhesive labeling machine (LWH-Series) for round bottles, flat/square bottles, cosmetic jars, and folding cartons.
models.application: Applies wrap-around, front-and-back, or tamper-evident corner labels with integrated thermal date/batch ribbon coding at 40-150 units/min.

models.name: Continuous Electromagnetic Aluminum Foil Bottle Induction Sealer
models.summary: Stainless steel air-cooled/water-cooled continuous electromagnetic induction cap sealer bonding inner aluminum foil liners onto PE, PP, PET, PS, and glass bottle mouths.
models.application: Provides hermetic, tamper-evident, leak-proof inner foil seals for capsule bottles (after SPN-400), cosmetic jars, mouthwash bottles, and agrochemical containers.

models.name: Automatic Vacuum & Nitrogen-Flushing Can Seaming Machine
models.summary: Four-roller sealed-chamber vacuum and nitrogen-flushing round can seamer for milk powder, protein powder, herbal granules, coffee, and lyophilized nutraceutical cans.
models.application: Evacuates oxygen from filled tinplate, aluminum, PET, or composite paper cans, back-flushes food-grade nitrogen (residual O2 <=3%), and double-seams the lid.
